lines: Ask this man to pray for you. The Prophet, peace be upon him, said it to Umar.
Uwais of Yemen. Dutiful to his mother.
Years later, Umar, Razi Allah hu Anhu, asked every caravan: Is Uwais among you? Until one day... yes.
And Umar asked him: ask Allah to forgive me. And Uwais did.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, mentioned his mother. Serve yours today.
